comment: Ranges removed from the published blacklists at build time (src/iplists/build-blacklists.py). A listed range that overlaps an exclusion is trimmed to the part outside it. Every entry names the source list, the reason and the date; review when the source list changes.

exclusions.reason: Private Internet Access VPN exit and proxy endpoints (Express-Equinix-London, RIPE). A user on that VPN sees every tunnel session of pia-daemon and of the browser's proxy helper flagged blacklisted (fmba-3: 253 of its 6,377 sessions, the operator Mac: 200 of 200 blacklisted sessions on 2026-11-03), and a blacklisted session is an unbreakable corroborator of the attack-pattern floor. The client's own tunnel to its provider is not an abuse indicator.
